findings.description: The autofill button populates example values, but does not prevent users from clearing fields after autofill. If a user clears the Source Table field and clicks Create, submission is correctly rejected with 'Source Table is required.' This is correct behavior but represents a minor UX gap.
findings.action: No action required; current behavior is safe and provides clear feedback.

findings.issue: Test connectivity always succeeds in local SQLite mode
findings.description: When running offline against SQLite, the test_table_connectivity function returns success: true for any 3-level catalog.schema.table name to enable Databricks-style namespace authoring without live infrastructure. In live Databricks mode, real SQL validation occurs. This is by design.
findings.action: Document this behavior in function docstring if offline mode is a supported deployment scenario.

findings.issue: No confirmation dialog before toggle Enable/Disable
findings.description: Toggling a project's active status immediately updates the database without confirmation. A user could accidentally disable a production project. The toast message appears after the action completes.
findings.action: Optional: Add a confirmation modal to guard against accidental disables of active projects.

summary: Implementation is complete and functional. All requirements met: CRUD operations return structured responses, catalog.schema.table parsing is safe, connectivity testing uses SQL semantics, Databricks errors are graceful, callbacks are clean with correct lifecycle management, modals open/close correctly, table refreshes after mutations, project details modal shows all required information, all data comes from metadata tables, and module organization is consistent with the existing codebase. Three minor non-blocking observations noted.
